title: Pre-Earnings Announcement Over-Extrapolation
one_line: Retail investors buy before earnings announcements of firms whose past announcement returns were strong; prices of those firms run up before and reverse after the announcement (78,000 brokerage accounts, 1991-1996).

findings.statement: Pre-announcement retail buying tracks past announcement returns; post-announcement reversal.

reported_results.headline: Retail investors buy before earnings announcements of firms whose past announcement returns were strong; prices of those firms run up before and reverse after the announcement (78,000 brokerage accounts, 1991-1996).

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
